sentence: And the retail evidence turns the channel configurational: performance comes from combinations of AI applications rather than single uses, and out of the combinations grow new capabilities, adaptive learning among them
passage: [Cao et al. (2025), p. 1] "we first construct a validated measurement instrument based on grounded analysis of 6,519 AI-related documents from 37 retailers. We then apply fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA) to survey data from 140 executives" / "superior performance stems not from isolated AI uses but from synergistic combinations--particularly those involving customer service and cybersecurity--interacting with other functions. These configurations appear to give rise to emergent capabilities such as adaptive learning, predictive analytics, and uncertainty mitigation"

gemini.note: The sentence accurately reflects the passage's empirical findings that superior performance stems from synergistic AI combinations rather than isolated uses, leading to emergent capabilities like adaptive learning.
